thread:
maya: heads up — after the kernel-selection change we rolled last night I'm seeing a 12-18% tail latency regression on TP+PP (8xA100) runs when KV-cache hot lookups are >40% of requests.

maya: repro with the small chat benchmark: 8g TP=2 PP=4, batch=4, seq=1024. median latency OK, p95 up ~14%.

perf-bot: perf dashboard updated: https://perf.internal/runs/1749543 — flamegraphs + NCCL traces attached.

arjun: looked into traces — all-reduce time increased across multiple layers. compute kernel changed to fused attention kernel (v3) which shrinks compute but increases point-to-point comm frequency. NCCL shows more smaller collectives.

arjun: rough numbers from one trace (single request path): compute down 9%, comm up 25%, overall p95 +13%.

selena: hmm — this smells like worse comm/compute overlap when KV-cache is sharded across TP slices. If KV hits are uneven, some ranks idle waiting on small all-reduces.

julian: agree. On interleaved KV placement we get more frequent KV cache lookups that touch different ranks per token. That increases number of sync points.

maya: is this TP vs PP specific? i.e., would DP (replicated) avoid it?

arjun: DP avoids cross-device KV lookups because each replica has full cache, so comm is lower but memory cost higher. In our budgeted Dedicated setups we picked shard-by-layer to save memory which makes TP/PP combos sensitive.

selena: quick mitigation idea: coalesce small collectives — add a minibatch-level NVLink aggregation before NCCL ops or change kernel scheduling to batch several KV lookups within a single step.

julian: another short-term: revert to kernel v2 for sequence lengths >512 where we saw regressions, and keep v3 for short sequences. That should reduce frequency of tiny all-reduces.

maya: can we get an experiment matrix? need to decide rollback or patch. Priority: customer-facing Dedicated clusters should be stable.

arjun: I'll run a 4x8-GPU sweep tonight: kernel v2 vs v3, KV-shard strategies: slice-local (current), interleaved, and replicated small-cache (LRU-approx). Collect p50/p95/p99 and NCCL op count.

arjun: test plan snippet:
```
configs = [
  {kernel: 'v2', kv: 'slice-local'},
  {kernel: 'v3', kv: 'slice-local'},
  {kernel: 'v3', kv: 'interleaved'},
  {kernel: 'v3', kv: 'replicated-small'},
]
metrics = ['p50','p95','p99','allreduce_count','avg_allreduce_bytes']
run_each(3)
```

selena: I'll add a tracing hook to label KV hits so we can correlate per-token which rank served it. want counts per-step.

maya: timeline?

arjun: sweep runs tonight, perf plots tomorrow morning. if v3 clearly regresses we should hotfix revert for Dedicated by EOD tomorrow.

julian: medium-term idea: implement batching window for KV queries: collect up to N lookups within T ms and serve together -> reduces number of collectives. Could be opt-in per-model.

maya: sounds good. action items:
- arjun: run sweep + upload traces (assigned)
- selena: add KV-hit labels to tracing and small script to compute per-step rank skew (assigned)
- julian: prototype coalesce window design doc (low-pri)
- maya: prepare rollback playbook for Dedicated (on-call)

selena: one more note — also check NCCL version differences across clusters. some Dedicated clusters are on 2.18.x, some on 2.16.x. behavior might differ.

arjun: noted. will include NCCL op histograms per version.

maya: thanks. ping here when first sweep finishes. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: sweep started (job 1749543-sweep-1). logs: https://logs.internal/1749543/sweep-1
